notes: The controller preflight deployed or reused only the content-addressed frozen source archive and launched no server/client training process.

The C2 client subset intentionally matches the canonical seed42 ECS-C2 topology: nine manifest-bound feature/classification/regression files and no local phase-label files. The loader therefore emits phase=-1 for C2, exactly as recorded in seed42 client_stats_round_001.json. Adding phase files would change the frozen protocol.
Server-side DA uses strict_calibration_split=true and therefore reads only C1/C2/C5 calibration_* arrays; it cannot fall back to source train/test arrays.
